Name: Death Note - The New World
Author: maroctocoffin1
Description:
[size=6][b]DEATH NOTE: THE NEW WORLD[/b][/size]
[b]Public Beta 1.4.2 | English and Russian | New farm required[/b]

[i]What if the world of Death Note existed inside Stardew Valley?[/i]

A quiet farm. Familiar neighbours. News of criminals dying under mysterious circumstances.
Death Note: The New World brings the Kira case into your farming life in an unofficial story expansion. Investigate alongside L, follow Kira's path, or remain neutral as events unfold around you.

Choosing a side and taking part in investigations is optional. Introductory scenes and background news may still appear.

[b]Publication notice:[/b] This page is an unpublished preparation draft. Distribution is on hold while artwork provenance and permissions are reviewed. No download is offered at this stage.

[size=5][b]FEATURES[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Three Paths:[/b] Neutral, L and Kira. Your choices shape which parts of the story you encounter.[/*]
[*][b]16 Investigations:[/b] The complete catalog across all routes. Availability depends on your path and story conditions.[/*]
[*][b]27 Story Scenes:[/b] The total across all branches, rather than the number available in one playthrough.[/*]
[*][b]Death Note and Shinigami:[/b] Obtain your own Notebook through the Kira path when its story conditions are met, and unlock Shinigami interactions. The Notebook is not given immediately on starting a farm.[/*]
[*][b]Downtown Zuzu:[/b] Follow city investigations using a free early shuttle, unlocked with the first public Kira news. Board at the separate Bus Stop road sign; return through the city bus door. This service does not repair the vanilla desert bus.[/*]
[*][b]Characters:[/b] Familiar Death Note characters alongside original project characters.[/*]
[*][b]Localization:[/b] English and Russian.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]HOW TO START[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Create a new farm and begin your farming life.[/*]
[*]Watch for the first news about Kira.[/*]
[*]Press J to open the journal.[/*]
[*]Take on investigations if you wish to become involved.[/*]
[*]Use the Zuzu shuttle when city clues become available.[/*]
[*]Make your own story choices. Choosing L or Kira is permanent for that farm.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Close Stardew Valley and SMAPI. Install SMAPI, then every required mod below, including those mods' own prerequisites.[/*]
[*]Open DeathNote_TheNewWorld_Public_Beta.zip. From its Mods folder, copy Death Note - The New World into your game's existing Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Check the final path: Stardew Valley/Mods/Death Note - The New World/manifest.json. DeathNote.TheNewWorld.dll must sit beside it. Avoid Mods/Mods.[/*]
[*]Archive old separate Death Note components before installing the unified package. Keep your farms and unrelated mods.[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI, resolve any missing-dependency messages, and select New Game. Existing story saves are not migrated.[/*]
[/list]Dependencies are separate downloads and are not bundled in this ZIP.

[size=5][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b][/size]
Target game: Stardew Valley 1.6.15 build 24356, Windows.
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.5.2 or later.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.9.1 or later.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8587]Downtown Zuzu[/url] CP component 0.9.4 or later; install its complete required package.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] 2.5.17 or later; install its complete required package.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42138]Reimagined Interior for Ridgeside Village[/url] 1.1.1 or later.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16168]Luan Indoor Tilesheets[/url] 2.8.1 or later.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14487]Sprites in Detail[/url] 0.6.1 or later.[/*]
[/list][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] is recommended for the Jenkins Residence story area; it is optional in the current manifest. Follow each dependency author's installation guide and prerequisite list.

[size=5][b]CONTROLS[/b][/size]
J - Journal.
V - Contextual investigations and story interactions.
K - Noct interaction when unlocked.
Some keybindings can be changed in the configuration; check your settings if a key differs.

[size=5][b]COMPATIBILITY[/b][/size]
Windows is the target platform. Start a new farm; existing story saves are not migrated. Do not run older separate Death Note components alongside this unified package.
Multiplayer remains unverified. Android and other platforms are not supported or tested for this release.

[size=5][b]KNOWN ISSUES AND TESTING[/b][/size]
Manual mouse/controller testing, multiplayer, and shuttle travel after repairing the vanilla bus remain unverified.
The full natural late-game second-Notebook sequence, every calendar/festival combination, all alternate choices and all multi-year endings have not been replayed on this build. Automated and native game API checks do not replace physical-input testing.
The Jenkins Residence integration safely defers when the expected compatible map is unavailable. Content totals cover the complete catalog, not a single playthrough.

[size=5][b]CHANGELOG — PUBLIC BETA 1.4.2[/b][/size]
First complete public-beta package prepared from the previous closed builds. These items include earlier closed-build work and the final release fixes:
[list]
[*]Unified Death Note mod distribution.[/*]
[*]Early Downtown Zuzu shuttle.[/*]
[*]Personal Death Note interaction corrections.[/*]
[*]RU/EN localization improvements.[/*]
[*]Farm notebook-fall scene offset fix for relocated farmhouses.[/*]
[*]Release integrity and documentation improvements.[/*]
[/list]This list does not imply that every feature was added in the final patch or that all endings were manually tested.

[size=5][b]SUPPORT[/b][/size]
After publication, use this page's Posts for general questions and its Bugs section for reproducible issues when enabled. This unpublished draft is not yet a public support channel.
Include your game version and build, SMAPI version, Death Note version, selected story path, problem description, expected result, actual result and steps to reproduce. Provide a relevant SMAPI log only after checking it for private information. Do not post private saves or personal data.
The TDAT portal's existing tracker is for Minecraft. A dedicated Death Note form, SMAPI fields, log attachment and successful delivery have not been verified.
